body_lead: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: An artificial intelligence-powered investigation platform developed by the Beed police has cleared a state-level technical evaluation, significantly improving its chances of being adopted across Maharashtra . The platform, DeepEye AI, is designed to support investigators through the entire lifecycle of a criminal case â from complaint registration to court trial monitoring.
